title: Chapter 1447 - 1: Lin Yuan'S First Tribulation

Chapter 1447 - 1: Lin Yuan'S First Tribulation

Chapter 1447 - 1: Lin Yuan's First Tribulation

(Part 2)

"It's not difficult."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even though the Jin Yue Dimension, like the Chaos Void, repels foreign temporal beings.

With the means of a Time Lord, one can integrate into it by paying the price.

Moreover, the Jin Yue Dimension is not exclusive.

And there is no time limit for this ordeal.

Lin Yuan observed the 'Abyss of Calamity' in the deepest regions of Wanwei Space-Time, aware that many calamities have strict time constraints.

If the trial is not completed within the stipulated time, it is considered a failure.

"They all say the first stage of the ordeal is not difficult for a lord, and now it seems true."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

At least the first ordeal he faced looked very simple.

"But even if it's simple, it must be taken seriously."

Lin Yuan showed no intention of underestimating, as every ordeal within endless calamities, whether easy or difficult.

If failed, he would be annihilated by the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

Lin Yuan did not want to stumble at a critical moment.

The will of the Supreme Rule Dao is equivalent to half a Fourteenth Rank existence.

If it personally annihilates, even if one can consume World-Breaking Origin Force to resist, the expenditure of the World-Breaking Origin Force would be like mountains and seas, and the force Lin Yuan has accumulated may not be enough.

"Well, it's right to go personally."

Lin Yuan's true self got up and took a step, disappearing into the

Chaos Void.

...

Decades later.

Lin Yuan finally traveled to the outskirts of the Jin Yue Dimension.

In the vast dimensional gap, even a Legendary Lord has not explored to the end.

"Is that the Jin Yue Dimension?"

Lin Yuan observed from afar a massive dimension space.

"Occupied by a Time Lord?"

Lin Yuan clearly sensed a formidable presence within the Jin Yue Dimension, stemming from a Time Lord.

Past space-time.

Green Cliff Mountain.

Time-Space Shop.

The twelve-eyed beast looked at Lin Yuan and smiled, saying: "The Jin Yue Dimension is the territory of the Dragon Stone Lord."

"Dragon Stone Lord?"

Lin Yuan appeared thoughtful.

Upon discovering the Jin Yue Dimension was occupied by a lord, Lin Yuan did not act rashly.

If he can purify the Jin Yue Dimension in a 'peaceful' way, Lin Yuan will definitely choose the 'peaceful' approach.

Using force to deal with the Dragon Stone Lord? Lin Yuan was unsure of the lord's control over the Jin Yue Dimension. What if the lord

could destroy the entire dimension in an instant?

Then even if Lin Yuan dealt with the Dragon Stone Lord, there would be no Jin Yue Dimension for him to 'purify,' leading to the failure of the

trial?

Of course, the likelihood of this is extremely low, unless one has refined a dimension space thoroughly as Lin Yuan, otherwise, even occupying a dimension space, a lord cannot cause it to collapse in a flash.

Furthermore, even if the Dragon Stone Lord had other means to instantly obliterate the Jin Yue Dimension, Lin Yuan could spend

World-Breaking Origin Force to prevent it.

But World-Breaking Origin Force is so precious, it's best not to use it

unless necessary.

"Why am I asking this?"

The Time-Space Shop owner curiously asked.

For sixty thousand years, Lin Yuan frequently visited the Time-Space Shop to purchase resources, becoming acquainted with the

twelve-eyed beast.

However, the twelve-eyed beast did not know Lin Yuan was the 'Galactic' of Wanwei Time-Space; asking for identity in a gathering place for lords like Green Cliff Mountain is impolite.

In the eyes of the twelve-eyed beast, Lin Yuan remained a lord with great potential in the future.

"I need to borrow the Jin Yue Dimension." Lin Yuan said.

He did not reveal the Jin Yue Dimension's connection to his endless

ordeals.

"Borrow the Jin Yue Dimension?"

The Time-Space Shop owner frowned, "The Dragon Stone Lord is in a

special state, and is not easy to deal with."

"Special state?"

"Difficult to get along with?"

Lin Yuan looked at the twelve-eyed beast.

"The path chosen by the Dragon Stone Lord for transcendence is

'Infinite Origin."

The owner of the Time-Space Shop, the twelve-eyed beast, explained:

"You know, the Infinite Origin' path to transcendence is extremely dangerous when exploring ancient time periods, especially when encountering the imprint remnants left by some terrifying beings... tsk

tsk..."

Lin Yuan listened quietly.

The past time-space holds countless secrets, the more ancient it is, the greater the risk, and the calamity of being lost is just one of them.

Even more unpredictable are the marks left by ancient beings, who have generally seen or even approached the end of a transcendence path but fell at the last moment, erased by the will of the Supreme

Rule Dao.

When the will of the Supreme Rule Dao descends to erase, no matter how powerful a Legendary Lord is, they must die, with no chance of resurrection, but the grievances and remnants left by a few terrifying beings are difficult to dissipate and remain in the past time-space. The most dangerous thing for lords on the 'Infinite Origin' path of transcendence is encountering these grievances and remnants, which can lightly influence and control one, or heavily cause the collapse of the mind and will.

"Affected by some remnant, the Dragon Stone Lord is in a mad state, with few moments of clarity, making communication difficult," said

the owner of the Time-Space Shop.

"I see."

Lin Yuan suddenly understood.

The Legendary Lord of Purple Light's self-deprecation that lords are

pitiful is not without reason; someone like the Dragon Stone Lord who can still maintain basic clarity is lucky.

"You want to borrow the Golden Moon Dimension; I can help negotiate with the Dragon Stone Lord, but it will likely require some

Sands of Time."

The owner of the Time-Space Shop said.

Involving a dimensional space is certainly not done for free.

"The Sands of Time is not a problem."

Lin Yuan immediately replied: "For anything under five million catties

of Sands of Time, I agree."

After the Wanwei time-space trip, Lin Yuan made a fortune, holding billions of catties of Sands of Time.

"That should work."

The owner of the Time-Space Shop nodded.

Five million catties of Sands of Time is more than enough for a single

use of the Golden Moon Dimension.

Not to mention, He would be handling it personally.

Outside the Golden Moon Dimension.

At the place where Lin Yuan was, suddenly an intention descended,

forming the shadow of the twelve-eyed beast, which was the avatar of the owner of the Time-Space Shop.

"I've already spoken with the Dragon Stone Lord; He will come out to

speak with you personally later,"

said the twelve-eyed beast.

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Soon.

In the distance, the Golden Moon Dimension suddenly stirred up

waves.

A colossal black dragon phantom emerged.

"Dragon Stone." The twelve-eyed beast immediately stepped forward,

appearing in front of the black dragon's shadow.

Lin Yuan also stepped up to follow.

"I've told you everything; this is the buyer." The twelve-eyed beast

introduced Lin Yuan: "He just wants to borrow your Golden Moon

Dimension for a million years, fifty thousand catties of Sands of Time is more than enough."

Lin Yuan offered the price of five million catties of Sands of Time, so the twelve-eyed beast naturally wouldn't take it out directly. "What do you want to use the Golden Moon Dimension for?" The

Dragon Stone Lord looked down on Lin Yuan, with a vaguely mad and chaotic aura.

"I'm quite interested in the operation of the Origin Dao within the

Golden Moon Dimension and want to borrow it to comprehend for a while." Lin Yuan found an excuse casually.

"I see..." The Dragon Stone Lord grinned: "Fifty thousand catties of Sands of Time is too little."

"Then how much do you need?" Lin Yuan asked.

"Fifty million catties of Sands of Time, not a catty less." The Dragon

Stone Lord stared at Lin Yuan.

"Fifty million catties of Sands of Time?" The twelve-eyed beast beside

him naused slightly. "Dragon Stone are you mad? Fifty million catties of Sands of Time? Your Golden Moon Dimension isn't worth that

much." "Dragon Stone, give me some face, two million catties of Sands of Time."

The twelve-eyed beast said in a deep voice. "Give you face?" The Dragon Stone Lord seemed slightly impatient,

"Time-Space, who do you think you are? You're not even a Legendary Lord, and you want me to give you face?"

The Dragon Stone Lord's tone started becoming frenzied: "I am a

Returning Ruins Lord who has passed the final phase of the third billionth calamity, about to reach transcendence, and you think you can bring up face with me?"

"Returning Ruins Lord?"

The twelve-eyed beast was quite helpless: "Dragon Stone, the Returning Ruins Lord perished long ago in the distant past time-space, your mind and will have been influenced by the remnants left by the Returning Ruins Lord in the past time-space, wake up." "I am the Returning Ruins Lord, and the Returning Ruins Lord is me."

The Dragon Stone Lord laughed recklessly, staring intently at Lin Yuan: "You have only two choices, either hand over fifty million catties of Sands of Time, or get as far away as possible."
